messages:
Sam (Sales): Hey team — SentinelBridge is asking about a migration POC from HelixAPI to Redwood. They care about response parity, pricing mapping, and we need to fill out a security questionnaire. Can SE + Platform take this? cc @Anna (SE) @Sridhar (Platform)
Anna (SE): I can run the POC. Quick q: what Helix endpoints do they call most? Need sample payloads and their acceptance criteria. Also, do they expect byte-for-byte parity or behavioral parity (same top-1 / semantics)?
Sridhar (Platform): Usually behavioral parity is enough, but for some finance customers they want exact event shapes. Biggest tech deltas we've seen: streaming event envelope differences and token accounting. Helix streams interleaved partial/final events; we stream SSE-like events. We can implement an adapter remap layer to reformat stream events to Helix shape. Also need to map rate-limit headers and retry semantics.
Elaine (Security): Heads up — they requested KMS support, VPC peering, SOC2 evidence, and audit log retention policy. I'll need their legal + network contacts to start the questionnaire. Do they require customer-managed keys?
Mike (Product): Pricing mapping note: Helix charges per-request for chat sessions; Redwood is per-token + model. For presales we usually produce a per-session cost estimate: take median tokens/session from their trace and multiply by our per-token rates + infra uplift. Ask them for 7-day traces.
Sam (Sales): They said they'll provide 3 days of logs initially. Acceptance criteria they gave: top-1 match >= 95% on our eval set, and median latency <= 350ms for short prompts. Also they'd like rate-limit parity so their client SDKs don't break. Is that achievable on Dedicated?
Anna (SE): Dedicated + quantized Llama variants should meet latency. POC checklist (short):
- ingest 3-day traces (anonymized)
- get sample requests + expected responses for 200 edge-case prompts
- deploy adapter remap shim in sandbox
- run head-to-head eval (20k prompts) and report top-1 delta + latency distribution
- complete security questionnaire answers
Example adapter remap (very small):
```json
{
  "map": [
    {"from": "helix.response.choices[0].text", "to": "output.text"},
    {"from": "helix.stream.event", "to": "redwood.sse"}
  ],
  "flags": {"truncate_preserve_system": true}
}
```
Sridhar (Platform): A few implementation notes: Helix truncation behavior trims system tokens before user tokens. We'll expose a `truncate_preserve_system` flag in the shim. Also preserve original request_id per-chunk — we'll add `X-Orig-Request` header so their observability links continue to work. Prefix/KV cache differences may affect warm latency — recommend enabling prefix cache for baseline runs.
deploy-bot: sandbox cluster provisioned: `sandbox-sentinel-01` (10.12.34.56). Credentials stored in LastPass entry `sb-poc-creds`.
Elaine (Security): Do they require IP allowlist or full VPC peering? If peering, we need their AWS account and network contact. Also confirm retention window for audit logs (most enterprises want 1 year minimum).
Sam (Sales): They prefer VPC peering. Contact is jessica@sentinelbridge.com — I'll intro. Also they'll want the security questionnaire filled by EOW.
Anna (SE): Next steps: Sam uploads anonymized traces + legal/network contact by EOD. I'll spin up the adapter shim and run an initial 2k prompt smoke test. ETA for initial report: Wed EOD.
Sridhar (Platform): One more: streaming header mapping — Helix includes `request_id` per chunk; we'll mirror it and include a mapping table in the runbook so their logs map back to our traces.
Mike (Product): For pricing calc I'll run the per-session estimate once we have median tokens/session from their traces. Will include a sensitivity table (p50/p90 tokens).
Sam (Sales): Awesome — I'll send the intro now and attach the logs when they arrive. Thanks :thumbsup:
